title: Live Jazz & Rooibos
description: Settle in for an evening of smooth jazz and our signature rooibos chai. Local trio "The Fynbos Notes" brings the soul.

title: Tea Tasting Sunday
description: Journey through 8 hand-selected single-origin teas from around the world. Guided tasting with snack pairings included.

title: Paint, Sip & Steep
description: Grab a brush and a cuppa! Our monthly paint night returns — no experience needed, just good vibes and creative energy.

title: Story Slam & Scones
description: Open-mic storytelling with freshly baked scones and cream. Share a tale, hear a few, and laugh a lot.

title: Acoustic Sunset Session
description: Watch the sun dip behind the mountains while local singer-songwriter Lina du Plessis performs live. Warm drinks, warmer vibes.

title: Winter Warmer Tasting
description: Cozy up with our new winter tea menu — bold chais, rich rooibos blends, and spiced hot chocolate flights.
